gates.summary: Hakuba Valley Safety Tips designate backcountry gates at five resorts. Leaving the ski area anywhere else is not permitted.
gates.gateSeasonNote: Gates open and close with snowpack and conditions — early and late season they may stay shut even when the resort is open.

rules.title: Exit only through designated BC gates
rules.body: Some areas next to the resorts are closed by agreement with local authorities. Entering them can cost you your lift ticket.

rules.title: Read the poles
rules.body: Yellow-and-black topped poles mark the resort boundary. Yellow poles mark closed areas. Terrain even 1 m outside the boundary is uncontrolled and unpatrolled.

rules.title: Submit a mountain itinerary (tozan-todoke)
rules.body: File your route before entering the mountains — online via Compass, with Nagano Prefecture's English itinerary form, or at a resort's designated ticket window.

rules.title: Beacon, shovel, probe — and a partner
rules.body: Travel in a group that includes experienced members and practice companion rescue.

rules.title: New to Japan BC? Hire a certified guide
rules.body: Check your guide holds a qualification from a national body in IFMGA (in Japan: the Japan Mountain Guides Association).

rules.title: Rescue is slow and can be billed
rules.body: In an emergency call 110 (police) or 119 (fire/ambulance) immediately.
